classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 0.05% of the pixels differ by more than 24 levels of a channel and every box has the same bounding box. What is left is the antialiased edge of the shapes. It covers transform-box (fill-box, stroke-box, content-box, border-box and view-box) on shapes and groups, rotations about x and y, translateZ and rotate3d, and perspective() and matrix3d() drawn as Chrome draws them in an svg, flat, with the perspective row dropped, and the order of paint around a shape with a perspective. With transform-box left out the same fixture measures 5.12%, with the rotations in three dimensions left out 3.10% and with perspective() left out 1.66%, so it fails each time.
